en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a broad town square or parade ground bordered by trees and long, classical buildings. In the distance are low mountains or hills. Benches and a few people are visible in the shaded central area. German captions in red label the view as Theresienstadt, with specific buildings identified as the town hall (Rathaus) and the commandant's house (Kommandantenhaus). Printer information is at the bottom.
